b:
Call the roller of big blunts,
the wispy, sleepy-eyed one, & order him
to the bodega w/ the dog dreaming
near candy bar shelves. The freezer lacks
cold cream sweets in pint & bar form
& frozen blueberries will not crush her craving.
Let there be sorbetto swirls of mucho mango.
The only empress is the empress of gelato.
She recovers from migraine blasts,
an itchy throat & thinks herself hideous.
But oh, what luscious eyes & lips! Magnificent nostrils!
In her throne of pillows & blankets, she will eat
basking in the royal blue glow of television.
Let her lap seat a Squishmallow & un gato.
The only empress is the empress of gelato.
